name: ashroot_animist_bonus_ends_with_the_turn
notes: M4 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever this creature attacks, another target creature you control gains trample and gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.' Ashroot Animist (4/4) attacks alone and targets seat 0's Bear, which stays home: 6/6 with trample this turn (seat 1 takes 4). On seat 0's next turn the Bear attacks alone (the Animist stays home: no trigger) and seat 1's 1/1 Cub blocks it: the Bear is 2/2 again and has no trample, so its 2 damage all go to the Cub (a trample answer [0] would put 1 on seat 1).
